agent_explanation: Single body in free fall with no walls and disabled controller gains energy every step (E0~1656.8 -> 1698.3 -> 1741.2 -> 1785.3 -> 1830.8) until exceeding E0*1.1+5 at step 4. With vx constant and |vy| growing under gravity, semi-implicit Euler adds more kinetic energy than potential loses, especially at high speed (~57-60) with coarse dt~0.021. Gravity=0 counterfactual holds energy exactly constant, confirming integrator energy creation, not collisions or controller work, is the cause.
